searchText: Does anyone know off the top of their head why the genesis beacon state for prater is much larger (28MB for the ssz file I think?) compared to the one for mainnet (5MBish iirc)? it is not, i think you mean below, thanks Because the prater genesis state was generated with a ton of validators already in it - far more than MainNet started with. Ah I thought it might come from Randao or some other params I don’t yet understand. What’s the point of starting prayer with so many validators and not have it copy mainnet then? So that it’s merge can happen faster.. or.. to stress test bls aggregation early on.. or..? Just to scale up to MainNet size from when it started. And to do so without having to spend goerli Ether 😄 And to reach a larger number of validators more quickly (if I remember correctly, prater started around a time where the activation queue was full and there were concerns that if we deposited organically we would never catch up with mainnet).
